page1_s1.raw_text: POLICY IS ISSUED ON THE CO-OPERATIVE ASSESSMENT PLAN@@@@ DECLARATIONS DOES NOT SUPERSEDE ANY CANCELLATION OR NON-RENEWAL NOTICES This policy: (1) replaces all previously issued policy Declarations, if any. (2) applies only to accidents, occurrences, or losses which happen during the policy period shown. (3) applies only to those coverages shown below for which a limit of liability or premium charge is shown. If *** appears in the coverage limit field, a coverage limit either does not apply or is described on the applicable endorsement form(s). "Our" limit of liability for each coverage shall not be more than the amount stated for such coverage, subject to all the terms of this policy.

page2_s3.raw_text: This policy is written on a continuous basis. Each period of one (1) year, ending on the annual anniversary date of this policy, constitutes a separate policy period. 1. The Policy Term on this Declarations began at 12:01 Standard Time at the described location for twelve (12) months from 10/14/2004 and for successive twelve (12) month Policy Terms as stated below. 2. This policy may be continued by payment of the required premium for the next Policy Term. The premium must be paid to "us" as specified in "our" premium notice. 3. Under the laws of this state, "we" may be entitled not to renew this policy under some circumstances. 4. If any of the forms attached to "your" policy are revised, "we" will furnish "you" with a copy of the revised form at renewal time.

page2_s4.raw_text: 5. If "we" adopt any revision of forms or endorsements during the policy period which will broaden coverage under this policy without additional premium the broadened coverage will automatically apply to this policy.
